p.text: Where does Sarah say Aziz should use his own voice?

fb.correct: 'In their building, yes. In the village, use your voice.'
fb.incorrect_default: 'In their building, yes. In the village, use your voice.'

1.say: Mr Karimov would write 'I think the district should keep the road'. In a letter to a friend, yes. In this report, no. 'One might argue that the district should keep the road.' That works, though 'one' sounds older than you are. 'It could be argued' does the same job. And why hide who is arguing? You are not hiding. You are saying that the argument stands whoever makes it. The next line tells the district what to do. Read it. 'Check the bridge every spring.' You are not their minister. 'It is recommended that the bridge be checked each spring.' That is four words longer and half as firm. It is also the only kind of advice a ministry will act on. Care should be taken with a reader who can say no. So the register does the work my voice cannot. In their building, yes. In the village, use your voice.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: Mr Karimov would write 'I think the district should keep the road'.

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: In a letter to a friend, yes. In this report, no.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: 'One might argue that the district should keep the road.'

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: That works, though 'one' sounds older than you are. 'It could be argued' does the same job.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: And why hide who is arguing?

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: You are not hiding. You are saying that the argument stands whoever makes it.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: The next line tells the district what to do.

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: You are not their minister. 'It is recommended that the bridge be checked each spring.'

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: That is four words longer and half as firm.

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: It is also the only kind of advice a ministry will act on. Care should be taken with a reader who can say no.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: So the register does the work my voice cannot.

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: In their building, yes. In the village, use your voice.
